subject: Warehouse sync
message: Is there any way to get our monthly numbers into our own data warehouse? Right now someone retypes them from the dashboard every month, which is error-prone.

subject: API rate limits
message: What are the rate limits on the read API? I could not find them in the docs.

subject: Archived rows in export
message: Can you make the export include archived rows? We keep them for compliance and right now they are silently dropped.

subject: Duplicate view behaviour
message: When I duplicate a saved view it copies the filters but not the column order. I cannot tell whether that is by design or a bug, but it makes duplication almost useless for us.

subject: Auto-archive is too aggressive
message: The product archives any ticket with no activity for 14 days. That is exactly the behaviour you documented, but it is wrong for us and I want it to stop.

subject: Bulk assign owners
message: How do I bulk-assign owners to 300 tickets? I can only find one-by-one assignment in the UI.

subject: Cannot find SSO
message: Your changelog says SSO shipped last week but I cannot find it anywhere in settings. Where is it?

subject: Permissions for non-admins
message: Can you make the scheduled-export feature available to non-admins? It exists but only admins can use it, and our analysts need it.

subject: Support response times
message: It took four days to get a reply last week. The product is fine, the support is not, and if it does not improve we will reconsider.

subject: Reports to Slack
message: Is there a way to schedule reports into Slack? I can email them on a schedule but I want them in a channel.

subject: 500 on /v1/orders
message: GET /v1/orders returns a 500 whenever the status filter is omitted. Repro: call it with no params, always fails. Started this morning.

subject: Too much manual work
message: Our whole Monday is manual data entry, about 200 rows a week by hand. There has to be a better way.

subject: Pricing
message: Renewal is coming up. Any chance of a discount if we pay annually?

subject: Export format
message: Please let the monthly report export as an Excel workbook. CSV is fine but finance wants formatting.

subject: Multi-currency
message: Before we roll out in Europe, does the data model support multiple currencies on one invoice?

subject: Filter resets
message: Every time I open the dashboard my filter resets to the default. It should remember my last filter. Please make it remember.

subject: Missing dark mode
message: I do not see the dark mode option anywhere. A colleague says it exists. Where is it?

subject: Competitor has anomaly detection
message: Your main competitor now does anomaly detection on dashboards. Do you plan to match that?

subject: Settings UI
message: The settings area is genuinely confusing and I think it needs a redesign. I waste time hunting for things every week.

subject: Price increase
message: Our bill went up 40% this quarter with no notice. We are disputing the charge.

subject: Large export limit
message: We cannot go live until the export handles 100,000 rows. Right now it times out at about 20,000.

subject: Onboarding call
message: Can we book a walkthrough for two new analysts next week?

subject: Unknown params error
message: The API rejects any request with an extra parameter it does not recognise. Can you make it just ignore unknown fields instead of erroring?

subject: I know it is not on the roadmap
message: I know it is not on your roadmap, but it would help enormously if you could add per-user audit trails to the activity log.
